companyContext: American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate that owns DC and distributes DC Studios films through Warner Bros. Pictures.
brandContext: DC (formerly DC Comics) is the iconic American comic book publisher and storytelling brand owned by Warner Bros. Discovery, home to Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, Supergirl and the DC Universe (DCU) film/TV slate produced by DC Studios under James Gunn and Peter Safran.

brandVision: To be the definitive home of the world's greatest super heroes — telling bold, hopeful, larger-than-life stories that span comics, film, television and experiences. With the relaunched DC Universe (Chapter One: Gods and Monsters), DC's vision for 'Supergirl' is to reintroduce Kara Zor-El as a harder-edged, cosmic Woman of Tomorrow: a hero whose pain fuels her hope, taking audiences on an interstellar road-trip that redefines what a Super hero story can feel like on screen.
brandValues: Hope, heroism, justice, courage, kindness and truth — DC champions characters who do the right thing against impossible odds. For Supergirl specifically: resilience, found family, empathy across the galaxy, and the conviction that even a sole survivor of a dying world can become a symbol of light for others.
